product_summary: Mumbai-based exporter (Mulund West, Mumbai 400 080), self-described 'Government Recognized Star Export House', trading since 1986, family-owned (founder Girish Brahmbhatt, now Sahil Brahmbhatt). Declared product lines on own website (sterlingexportsinc.com): (1) Herbs page — Harda/Yellow Myrabolan (Terminalia chebula), Himej/Black Myrabolan (Terminalia bellirica), Kapur Kachali, Rose flowers/petals, Senna leaves, Senna pods, Tejpatta/bay leaves, Tukbalunga, Tukmaria (basil seeds), Oregano, Thyme, Rosemary, Basil, Mace, plus 'many more crude drugs'; (2) Spices page — chillies whole/ground, turmeric, curry powder, coriander seeds, fenugreek seeds, fennel seeds, dill seeds, cumin seeds, black pepper, ajwain, cardamom, nutmeg, celery seeds, mustard seeds (yellow & brown), nigella seeds, annatto seeds, galangal roots; (3) Oil seeds; (4) Pulses & grains; (5) Raisins; (6) Rice and grains; (7) Food products; (8) Dehydrated onion & garlic; (9) mixed containers of spices/grains/oil seeds per customer requirement. Certifications claimed on site: HACCP, Halal, ISO 22000 FSMS, Kosher, FICCI, FSSAI.
comment: HS 121190 ('Plants and parts of plants... used in perfumery, pharmacy, insecticidal etc., fresh or dried, n.e.s.') is genuinely supported by the herbs/crude-drugs line: senna leaves and pods (Cassia angustifolia), harda/yellow myrabolan and himej/black myrabolan (Terminalia chebula/bellirica), kapur kachali, tukbalunga, rose petals, basil, oregano, thyme, rosemary — these are classic 1211/121190 items. So the declared code is NOT wrong, but it covers only a small slice of the actual range. Match status: partial. Missing from the declaration (all on the company's own site, none corroborated by a customs line in this review): spices — 0904 chillies and black pepper, 0902 tea-adjacent not applicable, 0910 turmeric/curry powder/ajwain/celery seed, 0909 coriander/cumin/fennel/dill/annatto, 0908 nutmeg & mace, 0907 cardamom, 0910 mustard seed (technically 1207.50), 1207.99 nigella; oil seeds 1207/1209; pulses & grains 0713; raisins 0806.10; rice 1006; dehydrated onion & garlic 0712.20 / 0712.90; galangal roots 0910.99. Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is broadly correct but imprecise — this is an agricultural-commodity/spice-and-crude-drug bulk exporter, not an FMCG brand owner; no packaged consumer brands are shown on the site. Trader signs: no manufacturing plant, no factory address, no processing capacity stated anywhere on the site; the About page describes procurement across India and onward export ('leading export house', 'procurement of spices and other food products throughout India'), i.e. an aggregator/merchant-exporter, not a producer. Website also carries template artefacts ('Construction, Since 1945. We Build Something New And Consistent', placeholder phone '+123 456 7890', 'addyour@emailhere'), which weakens the site as evidence of anything beyond a product list. Per project rule 5: every product line above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs/B-L line, GST turnover or public-procurement record was examined in this HS-only review, so actual shipments are unverified. Per rule 3, no HS mismatch justifies rejection; company is retained with the code corrected/expanded to the factual range. Note: no PAN, CIN or registration number was claimed or found on the site, so those fields are null — not researched here by design.
